title: Efficient comfortable and fun
text: We were too late to book the trip that included the guided tour so we booked a tour of the Alhambra separately. Catherine the guide on the bus was extremely helpful in liaising with the other company to arrange a meeting point for us. She was so charming and fun and made the bus trip very enjoyable. Mario the driver was very helpful too.
author: louisedG9978QM

title: Everyone should visit the Alhambra!
text: The Alhambra is a beautiful and historic place that anyone who visits Spain should experience. The bus was very comfortable and our guides and driver kind and knowledgeable
author: Mindy_C

title: An excellent day out
text: Although the coach journey was long it was comfortable and the trip well worth it. The tour guides were excellent and the palace and views stunning.. Not for anyone who has difficulty walking although there are breaks in the journey and time for lunch.
author: Wendy_B

title: Granada Day Trip Great
text: This tour is as great. It was beautiful, informative, and fun. Consuela was very engaging, knowledgeable and excitable. You can tell she loves her job. If you have a chance take this tour.
author: deanay2026

title: Wonderful
text: Wonderful all-day activity leaving Seville and going to Granada with a visit to the Alhambra. Consuelo guide at Alhambra very attentive.
author: taispsg

title: Excellent
text: Excellent experience. 100% recommended. Good place to visit because of the history, the views, the knowledge.
author: Renzo_C

title: Beautiful Experience Albaicin and Alhambra
text: We had a beautiful trip. We covered Albaicin and Alambra completely. The tour bus guide Jose Luis did a very good job of explaining Albaicin and history of Seville. Our guide at Alhambra Villalobos was very knowledgeable in Alhambra. Both places were very nice with different tome of Granada. We highly recommend this tour. A little bit on the pricey side and hotel pickup and drop-off would have been better.
author: jaiprakashr2023

title: Great
text: Thanks to our French-speaking guide Felipe!
author: 86lisev

title: Must do tour if visiting Sevilla to see the magical Alhambra!
text: This was a full day but very worth it and it flew by fast. Pia was an exceptional guide making sure we were taken care of and the trip went smoothly, as well as providing an excellent overview of the history of Andalusia, Granada and the Alhambra. We learned so much which made seeing these must-see awe-inspiring sites that much more meaningful and memorable. I would definitely recommend this tour and the company. They took great care of us and made it a fantastic experience.

title: Amazing
text: It was lovely experience, the guide Causelo was very good and Knowledgeable.
